items.q_en: What are research peptides intended for?
items.q_es: What are research peptides intended for?
items.a_en: All our products are research peptides, supplied for laboratory and research purposes only. They are not registered with Costa Rica’s Ministerio de Salud as pharmaceutical products, and we do not supply them for the diagnosis, treatment, cure or prevention of any condition. We do not provide dosing guidance, protocols or medical advice, and we can’t advise on personal use.

Al servir solo a Costa Rica, mantenemos la comunicación clara, confirmamos la disponibilidad del producto antes de que usted pague y entregamos sin problemas de aduanas o fronteras. Nuestro objetivo es hacer las cosas sencillas y confiables para los clientes locales.
